title: Sequence computation without recurrence
question: Which positions contribute, how do they contribute, and what still waits for an earlier step?

contribution.text: Follow two sentence-pair reads into a class decision.

beginner.heading: Predict each direction before reading
beginner.body: For each token, predict which other-sentence vectors contribute. Follow the two distinct denominators into a local comparison and a class score.

beginner.heading: Reorder the same representations
beginner.body: Explain why vanilla class scores survive either within-sentence permutation. Contrast fixed word vectors with distance-informed representations and the recurrent prerequisite.

beginner.heading: Check what an example can establish
beginner.body: Classify the reported errors and compare the two model rows without attributing a capacity-changing gain solely to order information.

expert.heading: Reconstruct both directional reads
expert.body: Derive both normalizers, shared local comparisons and separate sums; then prove within-sentence permutation invariance for fixed vanilla representations.

expert.heading: Audit optional order information
expert.body: Use the corrected distance denominator; distinguish parallel all-position reads from the recurrent Cheng tape and retain the printed objective sign.

expert.heading: State complexity and experiment conditions
expert.body: Retain both work terms and the length/dimension assumption; separate preprocessing, optimization and model selection from the authored arithmetic.

expert.heading: Audit classification evidence and versions
expert.body: Keep every accuracy and classwise row, unmatched capacity, qualitative errors and revision differences in a source-bound ledger.

contribution.text: Trace finite convolutional reach and source columns while decoding to EOS.

beginner.heading: Predict which prefix positions can contribute
beginner.body: Follow source columns and masked target positions through explicit dilation offsets. Explain why one reset does not erase earlier context.

beginner.heading: Continue beyond the width estimate
beginner.body: Contrast estimated encoder width with EOS stopping and training parallelism with sequential generation.

beginner.heading: Keep a gradient picture separate from a read
beginner.body: Identify units and conditions in the reported results. A gradient sensitivity example is not an attention distribution or an isolated speed measurement.

expert.heading: Separate source width from stopping
expert.body: Derive conditional factorization, stacked source interface, width estimate and EOS stopping. Do not invent integer rounding.

expert.heading: Enumerate paths across a dilation reset
expert.body: List exact offsets, masks, residual and normalization operations before computing a span. Keep finite depth separate from asymptotic path arguments.

expert.heading: Read each qualified relationship
expert.body: Separate named recurrent generalization, convolutional antecedents and the Transformer citation context; teaching adjacency adds no adoption edge.

expert.heading: Retain units, revisions and all results
expert.body: Preserve both tasks, decoding, complete tables, the canonical inconsistency, qualitative gradient maps and reproducibility limits.

contribution.text: Separate local convolutional reach from successive global source reads.

beginner.heading: Grow a local window through layers
beginner.body: Predict available positions after one and two convolutions; explain how a GLU differs from a recurrent memory gate.

beginner.heading: Read the source again before predicting
beginner.body: Follow a supplied layer state into a source read, then distinguish the next layer from the next target token.

beginner.heading: Separate position inputs from evidence
beginner.body: Explain where order enters, then interpret position and attention ablations under their actual conditions.

expert.heading: Reconstruct the convolutional block
expert.body: Crosswalk token/position embeddings, GLU, residual path, causal crop, normalization and initialization before interpreting depth.

expert.heading: Keep layer queries, keys and values distinct
expert.body: Reconstruct each layer query and its source-normalized read. Retain the bounded memory-hop analogy without transferring topology.

expert.heading: Record units and decoding conditions
expert.body: Retain data, tokenization, optimization and decoding separately from arithmetic and speed comparisons.

expert.heading: Audit tables, ablations and version imports
expert.body: Retain complete translation, ensemble, speed, position, attention, depth and summarization rows. Keep selected maps and earlier Transformer comparators version-bound.

contribution.text: Follow projected reads, shifted prediction and position signals in the original Transformer.

beginner.heading: Predict the available inputs for each read
beginner.body: Name source and shifted-target tokens, then identify which positions each of the three routes can read. Separate allowed access from a large weight.

beginner.heading: Follow two heads through the rest of the block
beginner.body: Trace different projections, concatenation and output projection; retain feed-forward, residual and normalization operations around the read.

beginner.heading: Explain where order enters
beginner.body: Compare permuting complete representations with moving tokens under fixed positions. Separate parallel training from autoregressive generation and short paths from measured speed.

beginner.heading: Qualify a reported result and a selected map
beginner.body: Compare canonical translation rows under their conditions. A selected attention map supplies no measured causal explanation.

expert.heading: Derive route origins and masks
expert.body: Reconstruct scaled dot products, projected heads and output projection in all three routes; retain shifted inputs and the complete post-normalized encoder/decoder block.

expert.heading: Separate order, paths and sequential depth
expert.body: Derive sinusoidal channels and permutation behavior with explicit conditions; retain Table 1 assumptions rather than substituting wall-clock claims.

expert.heading: Audit data, training and decoding
expert.body: Retain tokenization, batch and hardware conditions and revision-specific regularization.

expert.heading: Preserve canonical and arXiv evidence separately
expert.body: Retain all canonical results and ablations; keep parsing, selected maps, head-equation differences and conflicting results in their source versions.

interludes.title: A read inside a recurrent tape update

beginner.heading: Predict what has been written so far
beginner.body: Identify the earlier tape entries a recurrent step can read; contrast this with an all-token feed-forward sentence read.

expert.heading: Crosswalk prior hidden/cell tapes and parallel reads
expert.body: Retain paired hidden/cell retrieval within a sequential gated update. Concept adaptation transfers neither Cheng equations nor the full deep-fusion architecture.

beginner.heading: Count reads before the answer
beginner.body: Follow a supplied query, read and internal update; distinguish another read from generating another output token.

expert.heading: Keep residual and learned-map hop variants separate
expert.body: Compare residual u+o with the separately tied Hu+o update. The ConvS2S analogy permits no topology or QA-result inheritance.
